title: Thai basics
variety: Central Thai (standard Thai, as spoken in Bangkok)
about: The most common words of Thai (the Thai National Corpus counts as PyThaiNLP publishes them, the same counts as the app's Thai word list; see tools/course/th/rank.py), most common first, 50 to a unit. Names of people, places and nationalities are left out, and so are pairs of words the corpus counts together (ก็คือ, หรือไม่). Each word has one short everyday sentence in central Thai that uses it the way native speakers do, with its English translation; ⟦ ⟧ marks the part that translates the word. Each meaning starts with the word's reading in brackets, in the Paiboon romanisation the app uses for Thai.
